impact: Relief for PLTR after a steep slide; the TCV slowdown is the number bears will keep pointing at.
summary: Palantir rebounded after eight straight losing sessions, trading up about 5.9% at $169.77 per Benzinga. Citigroup raised its price target to $265 and kept a Buy rating, even as total contract value growth slowed to 6% from 49%.
title: Palantir snaps 8-day losing streak, up about 5.9%; Citi PT $265
